# Elements

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs` from src/shared/elements.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

SideDisplay has 58 elements. Each one shows its everyday options first; the ones marked _advanced_ are folded under **Advanced** in the editor.

- [Content](#content): Text, Image, Gallery, Slideshow, Video, Web page, QR code, Ticker, List, Sticker, Announcement, Menu board, PDF, Social wall, Shape, Wi-Fi
- [Time & dates](#time--dates): Clock, Date, Countdown, Calendar, Opening hours, World clocks, Timetable, Birthdays, Progress, Sun & moon
- [Live information](#live-information): Weather, Map, Air quality, Rain radar, News feed, Departures, Stocks & rates, Sports scores, Uptime, JSON / REST value, Chart
- [Home Assistant](#home-assistant): Entity, Entity list, Gauge, History graph, Camera, Now playing, To-do list, Template, Energy flow, Thermostat, Who is home, Alerts, Camera stream
- [MQTT](#mqtt): MQTT value, MQTT list
- [Layout](#layout): Columns, Grid, Switch, Carousel, Spacer, Divider
- [Options every element has](#options-every-element-has)

## Content

### Text

A heading or paragraph, with basic Markdown.

Refreshed by the server every 60 seconds.

| Option | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text |  | \*\*bold\*\*, \*italic\*, # heading, - lists, \[links\](https://…). Placeholders: {time}, {date} and {entity:sensor.some_id} (a Home Assistant state with its unit). |
| Text size |  | 12 to 400 px. |
| Alignment |  | Choices: Left, Center, Right. |
| Weight | advanced | Choices: Regular, Semi-bold, Bold, Black. |
| Line height | advanced | 0.9 to 2. |
| Uppercase | advanced |  |
| Text shadow | advanced |  |
| Letter spacing | advanced | -0.1 to 0.6 em. |
| Maximum lines | advanced | Longer text is cut with an ellipsis. 0 = no limit. 0 to 50. |
| Fit the text to the box | advanced | Sizes the text to fill the element instead of using the text size. Needs a known height: let the element grow, give it a fixed height, place it freely or put it in a carousel. |

### Free placement

Set **Placement** to _Free_ and the element leaves the layout flow: drag it anywhere in the preview, resize it with the round handle at its corner, nudge it with the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps) and rotate it from the options. Free elements are drawn above the layout, in the order of the element list.
